name: Clublinks Telco
summary: Melbourne telco (trading as Clublinks Telco, operator Clublinks Utilities Pty Ltd) serving master-planned golf/resort communities (Sandhurst, Sanctuary Lakes); retail site gone by 2018, brand defunct; parent CLUBLINKS PTY LTD (ACN 103 902 996) still active as Clublinks Communities.

events.details: Clublinks Utilities Pty Ltd (12 May 2005); trading as Clublinks Telco.

Retail homepage last captured live 2 Jun 2017; returning 404 by 3 Aug 2018. Telco brand defunct; a 2024 ABN cancellation applies to the operating entity Clublinks Utilities Pty Ltd, not to the parent CLUBLINKS PTY LTD.

ACN attribution: the cited CLUBLINKS PTY LTD (ACN 103 902 996) is the Melbourne golf/community management parent, ABN active from 27 Feb 2003 and still active (business name 'Clublinks Communities' from 25 Jul 2019) — not the defunct telco operator (Clublinks Utilities Pty Ltd). The parent's ABN was never cancelled.
